text:
devon: Hey all — need to lock a time for an AcmeCorp deployment review (Dedicated + VPC on-prem options). They want a 60m call to cover network, KMS, SSO, and rollout plan.

rachel: +1. Can we aim for next Wed or Thu? Acme is PDT.

megan: Wed/Thu both ok for CS. prefer morning 9-11am PDT.

anil: Engineering availability: Wed 10am PDT is tight, Thu 8:30–10am PDT works.

sam: SRE can do Thu 9am PDT. Also want to run through the failover plan and fallbacks.

devon: Ok looks like Thu 9am PDT is the sweet spot. If everyone agrees I'll send calendar invite.

rachel: Agenda draft: 1) Intros + scope (5m) 2) Network/VPC peering & VPN test plan (15m) 3) KMS/HSM integration + key rotation (10m) 4) SSO & SCIM mapping (10m) 5) Capacity & autoscaling profile for Dedicated (10m) 6) Rollout timeline & rollback triggers (5m) 7) Action items / next steps (5m).

megan: Add pre-req checklist discussion: what Acme must provide before cutover (connectivity test, certs, SSO metadata).

anil: I'll bring the sample VPN configs and a quick checklist. I'll paste the minimal iptables rules they should avoid.

sam: Can we also include a quick runthrough of the observability hooks in Redwood Console (token costs, latency dashboards)? Helps set expectations.

devon: Good call. I'll add it after capacity.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — include service account names for KMS access or the invite may be delayed.

rachel: Anyone want to own the runbook doc? I can put the initial template in the shared drive and assign owners during the call.

megan: I can own customer comms and follow-ups. I'll also collect the certs/SSO metadata beforehand.

anil: I'll own network/VPN prep. Will upload sample config to the doc by EOD Tue.

sam: I'll own observability & SLO items.

devon: Great. Action items before the call: 1) Acme to send SSO metadata + list of IPs (megan) 2) Anil uploads VPN samples (anil) 3) Devon adds Redwood Console slides + runbook link (devon) 4) Sam prepares SLO/alerting notes (sam).

rachel: Confirmed Thu 2025-11-13 09:00 PDT / 16:00 UTC (60m) — I'll send calendar invite with Zoom + agenda + doc link.

megan: Thanks — I'll ping Acme to confirm and ask for SSO metadata by Tue COB. :thumbsup:

devon: Thanks everyone. If anything changes react here.

rachel: Quick note for the call: please bring one screenshot of Console latency dashboard for similar-sized customers if you have it.

anil: I'll grab one.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Meeting invite sent to attendees.
